question: Intravenous antibiotics should be administered within 1 hour of presentation for an open fracture.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: The 1-hour window is the standard. Delays beyond 1 hour significantly increase infection rates. Do not wait for theatre or imaging — give antibiotics immediately.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. BOAST guidelines specify antibiotics within 1 hour of injury (or presentation) for all open fractures to reduce deep infection risk. Co-amoxiclav is first-line; gentamicin + metronidazole for penicillin allergy.
